entry.title: Food delivery startup Wonder files for IPO as it explores its next big bite
entry.summary: Following years of fundraising, acquisitions, and expansion, food delivery startup Wonder is moving closer to becoming a publicly traded company.

entry.title: Harbinger raises $240M after expanding into defense
entry.summary: The Los Angeles-based startup has now raised more than $650 million, and is working on electric trucks, emergency vehicles, and a driverless platform for the military.

entry.title: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
entry.summary: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

entry.title: The ex-Secret Service agent who flipped a hacker is now raising a second $250M cybersecurity fund
entry.summary: Stephen Ward, a former Secret Service agent and Home Depot CISO, is preparing a second fund of roughly $250 million for Brightmind Partners.

entry.title: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
entry.summary: Speaking at a Wall Street Journal tech conference on Wednesday, the executive touted how the company had been gaining ground in the enterprise market, where rival Anthropic had already successfully made inroads.

entry.title: US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers
entry.summary: A joint U.S. government statement says the hacks are affecting the food, transportation, and healthcare industries after reports of global mass hacks.

entry.title: OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?
entry.summary: OpenAI's newest cybersecurity model comes out as AI labs face scrutiny of their work to protect digital infrastructure.

entry.title: Meta warns that election backlash against data centers could make AI expansion harder
entry.summary: Meta warns that growing political opposition to data centers could threaten future AI investments, as communities push back against massive infrastructure projects.

entry.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
entry.summary: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.

entry.title: Serve Robotics launches new business to become the AWS for robots
entry.summary: Serve Robotics announced alonsgside its third-quarter earnings that it will launch a new business line called Physical AI Services to offer customers its connectivity and data tools.

entry.title: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
entry.summary: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.

entry.title: Meta, Google, and TikTok sue California AG over teen social media law
entry.summary: If it goes into effect next year, this California law would restrict social media access for children under 16.

entry.title: The New York Times reportedly in talks to buy Letterboxd for $330 million
entry.summary: Letterboxd, an online platform for movie lovers, has grown dramatically in recent years.

entry.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
entry.summary: Clutch, backed by Lightspeed and SignalFire, was last valued at $85 million, according to a source.

entry.title: At least 10 local governments have moved to drop Flock’s surveillance cameras since summer
entry.summary: The concerns range from privacy to how data is shared (and with whom) to procurement concerns.

entry.title: Tesla will stop making the Cybertruck in 2027
entry.summary: Elon Musk said the company will use the factory space to make more Cybercabs.

entry.title: Physicl raises $10M to make the digital world real enough for robots
entry.summary: Physicl is trying to solve the sim-to-real gap with a pipeline originally built to market goods online.

entry.title: Underdog shows off a 32MB speech model in new demo
entry.summary: Despite its small size, Underdog's new model can generate both speech and music.

entry.title: After blocking Muse, Amazon now lets users text Alexa to help them shop
entry.summary: Amazon said that the feature will roll out to millions of users in coming weeks.

entry.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
entry.summary: AI usage keeps climbing, but spending has stalled. Price cuts and smarter cost controls among the biggest spenders could challenge investor assumptions about AI hypergrowth.
